description: This script generates C++ header and source files for ANGLE format enumeration and format info tables, based on JSON data and format mappings. It includes functions for processing format data, generating code snippets, and writing output files.

methods.name: ceil_int
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of value divided by mod, ensuring integer division rounding up.

methods.name: is_depth_stencil
methods.description: Checks if the given angle_format specifies a depth or stencil channel.

methods.name: get_component_suffix
methods.description: Returns suffix based on component type for format naming.

methods.name: get_channel_struct
methods.description: Generates a string representing the channel structure based on format channels and bits.

methods.name: get_mip_generation_function
methods.description: Returns the mip generation function name or 'nullptr' based on format properties.

methods.name: get_color_read_write_component_type
methods.description: Maps component type to corresponding OpenGL type for reading/writing.

methods.name: get_color_read_function
methods.description: Returns the function name for reading color data based on format.

methods.name: get_color_write_function
methods.description: Returns the function name for writing color data based on format.

methods.name: get_named_component_type
methods.description: Maps component type string to OpenGL constant name.

methods.name: get_component_alignment_mask
methods.description: Calculates the alignment mask for format components based on channels and bits.

methods.name: get_vertex_attrib_type
methods.description: Determines the vertex attribute type string based on format ID.

methods.name: json_to_table_data
methods.description: Converts format JSON data into a C++ code snippet for format info table.

methods.name: parse_angle_format_table
methods.description: Generates the full format info table code for all formats.

methods.name: gen_enum_string
methods.description: Creates a string listing all format enums for the header file.

methods.name: gen_map_switch_string
methods.description: Creates a switch-case string for mapping GL formats to ANGLE formats.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script entry point; loads data, generates code snippets, and writes output files.
